Everything your team needs

One platform to message, automate and grow — no more juggling tools.

Shared Team Inbox

A real-time, multi-agent WhatsApp inbox. Assign conversations, reply with media, voice notes and quick replies — together.

Broadcast Campaigns

Build campaigns with a guided wizard, segment your audience and personalize every message. Watch delivery progress live.

Keyword Automation

Set up keyword bots that auto-reply, tag, assign and trigger webhooks — so routine questions answer themselves.

WhatsApp Templates

Create message templates in-app and sync approval status straight from Meta. Reach customers outside the 24-hour window.

Analytics Dashboard

Track messages, reply rates, response times and agent performance with a clean, range-aware dashboard.

Shopify Orders

Create and confirm Shopify orders right inside the chat — COD or prepaid — and auto-tag orders from customer replies.

A real-time, multi-agent WhatsApp inbox — assign chats, reply with media, never miss a message.

Secure by design

Your Meta and Shopify tokens are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Each tenant is fully isolated.

24-hour window aware

The composer knows the WhatsApp service window and switches to templates automatically — no failed sends.

Built on the official API

Powered by the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API — reliable delivery, real-time webhooks, no unofficial workarounds.
